topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I couldn't help but feel a certain way when my childhood best friend didn’t remember me. We spent every summer together, built forts and shared secrets. Yet, none of it seemed to ring a bell for them. I suppose time truly does wash away the trivial, although I never thought our memories together would be deemed as such. It’s a testament to the transient nature of human bonds, I suppose. Not everyone is meant to carry the weight of the past, and perhaps, this is a good sign. It means I have the capacity to be more than a fleeting memory, to be someone significant in other ways, in other lives.
